dedupe_keys.name: 防災に関する都民の意識調査 fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps series on tokyo open data catalog

description: 防災に関する都民の意識調査 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on Tokyo Open Data Catalog) is a series of datasets listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都総務局. 今後の都の防災対策を検討する上での参考とするため、都民、外国人及び地域の防災に対する意識及び現在の取組状況について、調査を実施した結果です。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都総務局. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
